name: Q35: H3 unfolding of Tumarkin's G12221
description: Compact hyperbolic Coxeter 5-polytope with 35 facets: the union of the 120 G12221 chambers around an H3 face.  Its Coxeter group is the kernel of the retraction W(G12221) -> W(H3); Q55 is its double across the facet E.

sourceRefs.citation: Pavel Tumarkin, Compact Hyperbolic Coxeter n-Polytopes with n+3 Facets, Electronic Journal of Combinatorics 14 (2007), R69.
sourceRefs.notes: Source polytope; the unfolding is a reflection subgroup of its Coxeter group.

sourceRefs.citation: Michael W. Davis, The Geometry and Topology of Coxeter Groups, Princeton University Press, 2008.
sourceRefs.locator: Special subgroups and retractions onto them
sourceRefs.notes: A retraction onto a finite special subgroup has a reflection-group kernel with fundamental domain the union of the chambers around the corresponding face.

notes: Facet labels: A = orbit of u1 (12), C = u5, B = u6, E = u7, D = orbit of u8 (20).
Vertex groups: H3xA1xA1 (60), D4xA1 (40), A3xA1xA1 (30), B2xA1xA1xA1 (20), A1^5 (50); index divisor 1920.
Further fibering work on this example is in progress and not yet published.
warnings: Geometric rendering factors normalGram numerically for visualization.
Dihedral angles were classified numerically (tolerance 1e-7) from the certified G12221 Gram matrix.
